definitions.full: H7151. qiryah קִרְיָה noun feminine town, city (synonym of עִיר , chiefly in poetry, and in the higher style; perhaps from above √ as meeting -place of men; compare proper name, of a location MI 13 קרית , l. 10 קריתן ; Jewish-Aramaic קַרְיָה ); — absolute ׳ק Isa 1:21 +; construct קִרְיַת Num 21:28 +; — 1 in General Deut 2:36 ; 3:4 . 2 of specific towns , Hosea 6:8 ( ᵐ5 גִּלְעָד, Manuscripts Γαλγαλα , compare Now); סִיחֹן קִרְיַת Num 21:28 ; Damascus, ׳ק מְשׂוֺשִׂי Jer 49:25 (|| תְּהִלָּה עִיר ); especially of Jerusalem Micah 4:10 ; Isa 29:1 ; 33:20 , ק ׳רְחֹבוֺת Lam 2:11 , ׳ק רָ֑ב מֶלֶךְ Psa 48:3 , city for inhabitants 1Kin 1:41 , 45 , נֶאֱמָנָה ׳ק Isa 1:21 , 26 (|| הַצֶּדֶק עִיר ), ׳ק עַלִּיזָה 22:2 (|| הוֺמִיָּה עִיר ), 32:13 . 3 in Isaiah 24-26 collective, i.e. denoting various, representative, cities , ׳ק תֹּהוּ Isa 24:10 , בְּצוּרָה ׳ק 25:2 , ׳ק עָרִיצִים גּוֺיִם 25:3 , ׳ק נִשְׂגָּבָה 26:5 ; so probably Hab 2:8 , 17 . 4 indefinite, Hab 2:12 (|| עִיר ); Prov 29:8 , ׳ק עֹז 18:19 a city of strength , so ׳ק עֻזּוֺ 10:15 (in figurative) = 18:11 ( id. ); = inhabitants, 11:10 , ק ׳הֲמוֺן Job 39:7 . קִרְיַת see יְעָרִים קִרְיַת . above

occurrences.englishText: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon,
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”
Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
He scorns the tumult of the city,
God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city.
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices.
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city,
A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city.
Mockers stir up a city,
How the faithful city has become a prostitute!
I will restore your judges as at the first,
You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city.
Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land;
Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals.
How is the city of praise not forsaken,
My eyes fail with tears.
Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity;
Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion,
Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.
Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals, which made them afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.
